howItWorks.title: How HARX Works
howItWorks.subtitle: No infrastructure. No hiring. No upfront cost. No complexity. Just a certified team, a live AI scoring every interaction, and a simple rule : you pay only when it works.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Define your campaign, your leads, your script, and what a transaction means for you. Our AI generates everything else.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Harx AI matches your gig to the right certified agents from our global network. Language, industry, activity — every dimension scored and verified.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Set your own compensation levels. You set the amounts, guided by AI benchmarks. harx takes a portion (%) only when your rep earns a transaction.
howItWorks.step4Title: You only pay what it's worth.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Floor for effort. Commission for results. Bonus for excellence.
howItWorks.floorDesc: Pay for a serious, argued interaction
howItWorks.commissionDesc: Pay when a transaction is confirmed
howItWorks.bonusDesc: Pay when your target is reached
howItWorks.step5Title: Your budget is a contract, not an estimate
howItWorks.step5Desc2: You decide how much a gig costs — down to the cent.
howItWorks.step5Desc3: You define the price of effort; You define the price of performance; You only pay when it happens.
howItWorks.step5Desc4: Reps take the lion's share; Harx takes a portion; AI verifies everything.
howItWorks.step5Desc5: Beyond performance, three simple costs : Your plan. Your numbers. Your minutes.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Transcribed, analyzed and scored in seconds by AI : Fraud detected, Sentiment measured, Transaction confirmed.
howItWorks.step7Title: Scale globally — 60,000+ certified agents across 70+ countries
howItWorks.step7Desc: Harx works with human agents today, AI agents tomorrow, and any mix in between.
howItWorks.ctaTitle: You have leads. We have agents. You pay per result. HARX the Transaction as a Service™ Platform powered by AI
